name: Camtono (Champion)
text: A camtono is a secured, handle container used for transporting valuable goods. A camtono comes with one key. Without the key, unlocking the camtono requires a DC 30 security kit to force open. It stores 10 lb., not exceeding 3/8 cubic foot, has an AC of 15, and 90 hit points. Destroying the camtono risks damaging any goods stored inside.
